create_dataset_feature: create a tfds Dataset feature to encode nested datasets with inner feature specs
encode_example_dataset: encode an example dict or iterator into serialized nested dataset elements
decode_example_dataset: decode serialized nested dataset elements into a tf.data.Dataset
decode_example_np_dataset: decode serialized nested dataset elements into a lazy PythonDataSource
get_tensor_info_dataset: get the TensorInfo with dataset nesting level added for shape metadata
